headline: With a Good Collection of Running Backs, Put the Kittle On Should Stake a Claim for the League's Top Spot
summary: After a strong showing from the fifth draft slot, Put the Kittle On is a team to keep an eye on, assembling a roster that has the ability to reach the postseason. They jumped on ball-carriers early, using three of their first four picks to acquire running backs. Corresponding with that strategy, Put the Kittle On landed the best quartet of running backs in the league.
